The perceptual quality auditor found no global distortions, confirming the image is visually clean aside from these specific structural/textural issues.

The alignment is high because the primary subject is structurally sound and taxonomically accurate, despite minor uncertainties in the obscured hind limbs.

The pose auditor's low confidence in hind limb keypoints correlates with the visual difficulty in resolving those areas, suggesting minor structural ambiguity rather than gross failure.
